title: 第91章 持续推进第90章 低调
content_zh:
“这片山区，仍然是我的主场，虽然地面的森林会影响我的掌控战场力度，但我现在是六阶的元神，可以弥补这些漏洞。”
石小军现在跟三年前相比，又是另一番景象。
顺利晋升六阶之后，他在家族里的地位，已经跃升了好几级，现在也是长老级的职位，不过他不想担任军团里的军职，仍然以独自一人的侦察员身份自由出入于地下世界。
因为他长时间都在地下某处空洞里进行修炼，从来不在地面露脸，即使是传递侦察信息，也是通过龙界网络来交流。
带领团队在地下穿梭奔赴魔巢的时候，他也不需要现身，相隔百里之外，都能够轻松操作，运输人员在地下行军。
所以他也成为最神秘的地下暗影者，连家族内部都只有少数人知道他现在的变化，知道他的成长进度。
他晋升六阶的消息一直没有对外公开，以免过于惊世骇俗引来不必要的关注。
在短短数年内，他从四阶一路狂飙急升，迈入化神境，成为家族里举足轻重之人，并且他的成长还没有停滞，以他现在的进度，突破到合体境也不需要十年，估计在完全收复这片超级大陆的时候，他就能迈入高阶修士的行列。
中央山脉区的扫荡进程，确实够慢，有些军团对付山中妖兽群，就花费不少工夫，这些属于顶级资源，各家军团也不介意，所以在清理魔军的同时，把山中的妖兽也梳理一遍，能杀的都杀了。
一些化妖的妖兽，只能逃亡，它们不敢跟人族交涉，打又打不过，万一人族不讲理，它们就是白送的。
有些不幸遇到九阶统领带队清理的，逃不过，都吓得跪地求饶了。
龙族有专门处理化妖群体的部门，中央山脉万里区域都是无人区，是险地，妖兽横行之所，化妖者众。
特殊处理部门专门给这些大妖进行登记，统一管理，确定它们的活动范围，要求它们以后都只能在自己的地盘上活动，如果需要离开自己地盘到别处去，得汇报到特殊部门，得到批准之后才能动身，否则属于违法行为，会受到制裁。
不想登记的都进行了清理，剩下的那些摇摆不定的都不敢造次，陆续主动站出来请求登记。
完成登记之后，龙族相关部门要求它们看好自己的地盘，如果有魔族成员的踪迹，需要及时汇报，要是发现它们知情不报，同样会得到严惩。
可以说妖族管理部门的介入，让战线的推进变得更加缓慢，但是对于整片区域的治理，却有巨大的好处，让这里的大部分区域，纳入统一管理体系，可以有效防止魔族残余力量潜藏在山林之中。
石小军带领家族军团在山体中穿梭，寻找魔族残余部落是有些不如人意，几乎没什么收获，但是在寻宝方面，却是惊人的好使，他们几乎完全变成了山中寻宝队伍，每天都在山中各处转悠，专盯着山中矿脉，寻找伴生矿灵宝，还灵脉中滋生的灵物材料。
偶尔发现的魔族小队，都只是额外收益，不值得一提。
这次中央山脉的战线，只维持了两年半，就清理完毕，比大家预想的要快得多，毕竟大云雾山只是它的其中一条支脉，都花了近三年时间才清理干净，这里更加庞大更加复杂地型的环境，反而用了较短时间就处理好。
石家军在战后分析中，点出其中的原因，一是本来这片区域就有数量庞大的妖兽群，魔族军团进入里面，并没有立足之地，容易受到妖兽的排斥攻击，所以它们无法在这里开辟大型的据点，只能小股的隐藏在山洞里面。

这样魔军的大部队，只能撤到后面的防线上去，没留下多少军团，也就不会有太多转入地下的残余。
但因为范围实在太大，慢慢推进也是极消耗时间的，处理妖族的登记也耗费了大量时间。
越过中央山脉战线，意味着这片大陆已经有超过一半落入龙族的管理，两侧的推进比中央要更加迅速，对剩余的陆地区域，形成一个小包围之势。
后面那些魔军，战斗抵抗都弱了两个层次，推进更加势如破竹，若不是地下清理需要时间，他们在三个月内就可以推平全境了。
随着魔族残余数量的减少，并且降临的军团更多，积分争夺更加激烈，排行榜上的积分普遍都大幅度下降，排名变化也更加剧烈，一次征战收益，可能会让你的名次连升几十名。
石家军反而在这种形势下，展现出优势，即使没有刻意争夺排名，也能挤进前十了。
与石家合作的军团也更多了，在大家友好合作的氛围下，他们的排名虽然引人注目，倒也没有引起宵小的关注。
主要还是排名靠前的军团，都跟他们有过合作。
经过几年的经营，他们与龙族内部各势力以及赤月新领主势力，都有相当不错的友好合作，彼此利益相关，所以也没有不长眼的领主敢暗算。
石小军也到了冲击高阶境界的关键时刻了。
高阶与中阶的差距，还是非常明显的，其中最明显的就是元神的强度以及高度。
六阶的元神不过是十米左右就升不到了，只有突破到七阶，才能再次提升。
“感应范围更广了，现在千里之外的地下，都已经成为我随时查看的后花园，魔族残余势力再也没有容身之地，如果我全力辅助各军团扫荡，恐怕不用半年就能把这片战线的地下肃清。”石小军现在不但是自己元神变强了许多，大地支柱的升级也没有停止。
尤其是前段时间，器灵诞生，他把更多时间都花在培养器灵上面。
拥有器灵的宝具，可以自己出战，不需要主人过去，但是小军即使没有宝具在手，只要还能感应到它的位置，就可以借助它的力量，保持对地下土层的控制。
因此现在他可以把器灵派出去寻宝，自己则保持着修炼状态。

content_en:
"This mountainous area is still my home ground. Although the forest on the ground will affect my ability to control the battlefield, I am now a sixth-level soul and can make up for these loopholes."
Compared with three years ago, Shi Xiaojun is in a different situation.
After successfully being promoted to the sixth level, his status in the family has jumped several levels, and he is now an elder. However, he does not want to hold a military position in the legion and still freely travels in and out of the underground world as a single scout.
Because he has been practicing in a cave somewhere underground for a long time and never shows his face on the ground. Even if he transmits reconnaissance information, he communicates through the Dragon Realm network.
When leading the team to shuttle underground to the Demon Nest, he does not need to show up. He can easily operate it from hundreds of miles away, transporting people to march underground.
Therefore, he has become the most mysterious underground shadow person. Even within the family, only a few people know about his current changes and his growth progress.
The news of his promotion to the sixth level has not been made public to avoid being too shocking and attracting unnecessary attention.
In just a few years, he rose rapidly from the fourth level to the realm of gods, becoming a very important person in the family, and his growth has not stagnated. With his current progress, it will not take ten years to break through to the fusion realm. It is estimated that when this super continent is completely recovered, he will be able to enter the ranks of high-level monks.
The cleanup process in the central mountain range is indeed slow enough. Some legions spend a lot of time dealing with the monster beasts in the mountains. These are top-level resources, and each legion does not mind, so while cleaning up the demon army, they also sort out the monsters in the mountains and kill all they can.
Some of the demonic beasts had no choice but to flee. They did not dare to negotiate with the humans and could not be beaten. If the humans were unreasonable, they would be given away for free.
Some of them were unfortunate enough to encounter the ninth-level commander who led a team to clean up. They couldn't escape and were so frightened that they knelt down and begged for mercy.
The Dragon Clan has a department that specializes in dealing with groups of demon-turned-monsters. The central mountain range is an uninhabited land, a dangerous place where monsters roam rampant and there are many demon-turned-monsters.
The special handling department specially registers these big demons, manages them in a unified way, determines their scope of activities, and requires them to only move on their own territory in the future. If they need to leave their territory to go elsewhere, they must report to the special department and obtain approval before they can leave. Otherwise, it is illegal and will be punished.
Those who did not want to register were cleared away, and the remaining wavering ones did not dare to make a mistake and came forward one after another to request registration.
After completing the registration, the relevant departments of the dragon clan asked them to keep an eye on their own territory. If there are traces of demon clan members, they need to report them in time. If they are found to have knowledge and fail to report, they will also be severely punished.
It can be said that the intervention of the demon clan management department has made the front line advance more slowly, but it has huge benefits for the governance of the entire area. Bringing most of the area here into a unified management system can effectively prevent the remaining demon clan forces from hiding in the mountains and forests.
Shi Xiaojun led the family army to shuttle through the mountains. The search for the remaining demon tribes was a bit unsatisfactory, with almost no harvest, but they were amazingly good at treasure hunting. They almost completely turned into a treasure hunting team in the mountains. They wandered around the mountains every day, focusing on the mineral veins in the mountains, looking for the associated mineral treasures, and the spiritual materials that grew in the spiritual veins.
The occasionally discovered demon squads are just additional benefits and not worth mentioning.
This time, the front line in the Central Mountain Range was maintained for only two and a half years before it was cleared, which was much faster than everyone expected. After all, the Great Yunwu Mountain was just one of its branches, and it took nearly three years to clear it. The larger and more complex terrain environment here was dealt with in a shorter time.
In his post-war analysis, Shi Jiajun pointed out the reasons. First, there were originally a large number of soldiers in this area.A large group of monster beasts, and the demon army has no place to stand inside, and is easily repelled and attacked by the monster beasts. Therefore, they cannot open up a large stronghold here, and can only hide in small groups in the caves.
In this way, the large forces of the demon army can only withdraw to the defense line behind them. Without many legions left, there will not be many remnants that go underground.
But because the scope is so large, it is very time-consuming to slowly advance, and it also takes a lot of time to process the registration of the demon clan.
Crossing the central mountain range front means that more than half of this continent has fallen under the control of the Dragon Clan. The two sides are advancing faster than the center, forming a small encirclement of the remaining land area.
The combat resistance of the demonic armies behind them was two levels weaker, and their advance was even more overwhelming. If it hadn't been for the time required to clean up the underground, they could have bulldozed the entire territory within three months.
As the number of demon clan remnants decreases and more legions arrive, the competition for points becomes more intense. Points on the rankings generally drop significantly, and ranking changes become more drastic. Gains from one battle may increase your ranking by dozens of places.
On the contrary, Shi Jiajun showed an advantage in this situation. Even if he did not deliberately compete for rankings, he could still squeeze into the top ten.
There were more legions cooperating with the Shi family. In the atmosphere of friendly cooperation, although their rankings were eye-catching, they did not attract Xiao Xiao's attention.
Mainly the top-ranked legions have cooperated with them.
After several years of operation, they have established quite good friendly cooperation with various forces within the Dragon Clan and the forces of the new lord of Chiyue, and their interests are related to each other, so no unsighted lord dares to plot against them.
Shi Xiaojun has also reached the critical moment to hit the high-level realm.
The gap between high-level and mid-level is still very obvious, the most obvious of which is the strength and height of the soul.
A sixth-level soul can't be raised beyond about ten meters. Only by breaking through to seventh level can it be raised again.
"The sensing range has become wider. Now the underground thousands of miles away has become a back garden that I can check at any time. There is no place for the remaining demonic forces. If I fully assist the legions in the sweep, I am afraid that it will not take half a year to clear the underground of this front." Shi Xiaojun has not only become much stronger in his soul, but also has not stopped upgrading the earth pillars.
Especially when the weapon spirit was born some time ago, he spent more time cultivating the weapon spirit.
With the Noble Phantasm of the weapon spirit, he can go into battle on his own without the need for the master to go over. However, even if Xiaojun does not have the Noble Phantasm in hand, as long as he can still sense its position, he can use its power to maintain control of the underground soil.
So now he can send the weapon spirit out to hunt for treasures while he maintains his cultivation state.
